h1: Morpheus8 Burst RF Microneedling in Huntington Beach
intro: Morpheus8 by InMode is a radiofrequency (RF) microneedling treatment: tiny needles enter the skin and release RF energy beneath the surface to contract tissue and start the skin’s natural renewal process. At CAIR SPA in Huntington Beach we use the newest Morpheus8 Burst and Burst Deep handpieces on InMode’s IgniteRF platform to treat the face, neck and body, with no incisions and no stitches.

whatIs: Morpheus8 combines two proven ideas. Microneedling creates microscopic channels in the skin, and radiofrequency energy gently heats the tissue beneath it. In Morpheus8, the needles themselves deliver bipolar RF energy at a depth the provider selects, creating tiny zones of controlled heat under the surface while the outer skin is largely protected. The body responds to these zones with its natural wound-healing process, which includes building new collagen and elastin over time.

The Burst handpieces add InMode’s Burst and Scale technologies. In a single pulse, the needles deliver energy at several depths in quick succession, in millisecond intervals, with programmable energy levels. That lets one pass treat multiple layers of tissue. Morpheus8 Burst uses smaller tips for the face, neck and smaller body areas, while Morpheus8 Burst Deep uses a larger 40-pin tip designed for larger body areas and the deepest levels of energy the system offers. Needle depth is adjustable, up to 7 mm according to InMode’s FDA filing.

Morpheus8 is FDA-cleared for dermatologic procedures that require coagulation or contraction of soft tissue. Providers commonly use it to improve the look of skin laxity, texture, enlarged pores, fine lines and acne scarring, and published clinical experience supports these uses, but results vary from person to person. All services at CAIR SPA are performed under Tran Plastic Surgery, led by Dr. Tuan Tran, a triple board-certified plastic, reconstructive and hand surgeon.
goodFor: Loose or crepey skin on the lower face, jawline and neck
Uneven skin texture and enlarged pores

People who want a non-surgical option with no incisions or stitches

steps.title: Consultation and plan
steps.text: Your provider reviews your goals, skin type, medical history and medications, explains benefits and risks, and decides which handpiece, depths and energy settings suit each area.

steps.title: Numbing and preparation
steps.text: Your skin is cleansed and a topical numbing cream is applied and left on, often for about an hour. It is fully removed and the skin is cleaned again right before treatment.

steps.title: Morpheus8 Burst treatment
steps.text: The handpiece is placed on the skin and the fine needles deploy with each pulse, delivering RF energy at several depths. The provider works across the area in a planned pattern, usually in about 20 to 60 minutes.

steps.title: Aftercare and healing
steps.text: You go home the same day with aftercare instructions. Redness, swelling and tiny grid-like marks are common for a few days while the skin heals.

steps.title: Results and follow-up
steps.text: Collagen remodeling continues for weeks after each session, so improvement appears gradually. Many plans include a short series of treatments spaced several weeks apart.

expect.before: Tell your provider about medications, supplements, skin conditions, cold-sore history and any implants or devices. You may be asked to pause retinoids or other active skincare and avoid sun exposure beforehand. Arrive with clean skin and no makeup.
expect.during: After numbing, most people feel heat and pressure with each pulse, and some areas feel more intense than others. The provider adjusts depth and energy area by area and checks on your comfort throughout.
expect.after: Expect redness, swelling and small grid marks for a few days, sometimes longer on the body or after deeper settings. Use gentle skincare, avoid sun, heat and strenuous exercise as instructed, and wear sunscreen daily. Contact us right away if you notice blistering, worsening pain or signs of infection.

faqs.q: Does Morpheus8 involve incisions or stitches?
faqs.a: No. Morpheus8 is a microneedling treatment, not surgery. Fine needles create microscopic channels that heal on their own, so there are no incisions, no stitches and no general anesthesia.
Pricing depends on the areas treated, the handpiece used and how many sessions your plan includes. Book a free consultation at CAIR SPA and you will receive an exact quote before anything begins.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Morpheus8 Burst and Burst Deep?
faqs.a: Both deliver radiofrequency energy through microneedles at several depths in one pulse. Burst uses smaller tips suited to the face, neck and smaller areas, while Burst Deep uses a larger 40-pin tip designed for larger body areas and the deepest energy the system offers. Your provider chooses based on the area and your goals.

faqs.q: How long is the downtime after Morpheus8?
faqs.a: Most people have redness, swelling and small grid-like marks for a few days, and many return to normal routines quickly. Deeper or body treatments can take longer to settle. Your provider will give you a personal aftercare plan.

faqs.q: How many Morpheus8 treatments will I need?
faqs.a: It depends on your concerns and skin. Many plans use a short series of sessions spaced several weeks apart, while some people choose a single session. Results build over the months after treatment as new collagen forms.

faqs.q: Is Morpheus8 safe, and who should avoid it?
faqs.a: Morpheus8 is FDA-cleared, and treatment at CAIR SPA is performed under Tran Plastic Surgery after a full consultation. Like all RF microneedling, it carries risks, and in October 2025 the FDA reminded patients that rare complications such as burns, scarring, fat loss and nerve injury have been reported. It is generally not advised during pregnancy, with active skin infection, or with certain implanted electronic devices, and settings are adjusted for different skin types. Your provider will review your history and discuss benefits and risks with you.
